source_notes: GNI confirmed the site for its state-led Strategic Gas Emergency Reserve (SGER) FSRU as Cahiracon, Co. Clare, on the Shannon Estuary; announced 26 Nov / 10 Dec 2025. Sponsor's own project page (gasnetworks.ie) and RTE both state 'Cahiracon, Co. Clare, along the Shannon Estuary'; maritime-executive corroborates. This resolves the existing RR note 'consider renaming terminal once an official name or location is provided'. 14 sites screened; Cahiracon selected after multi-criteria/cost-benefit analysis (Cork Harbour and Shannon Estuary shortlisted). All three URLs PASS url_verifier.
